description: Manage projects, issues, and workflows with Jira Cloud. Use when a user asks to set up Jira projects, create and manage issues, configure workflows, build Jira integrations, automate issue transitions, set up boards (Scrum/Kanban), manage sprints, use Jira REST API v3, create webhooks, build custom JQL queries, configure permissions and schemes, set up automation rules, or integrate Jira with CI/CD pipelines.
